# Third-party licenses

## tweetnacl

Public domain. Written in 2014 by Dmitry Chestnykh and Devi Mandiri, from TweetNaCl by Daniel J. Bernstein, Wesley Janssen, Sjaak Lange, Peter Schwabe, and Tanja Lange.

The file `nacl.js` is [tweetnacl](https://github.com/dchest/tweetnacl-js) 1.0.3. Origami Ape uses it only to verify a wallet `signMessage` proof for holder unlocks. It is the same check used by Mirmobe Meme Crucible. The app never asks for a seed phrase or a private key.
